unsupported: Founded by Bob Miller, the shop focuses on custom furniture and woodworking.
The operation is small-scale, with Miller handling design, fabrication, and instruction.
Customers include individuals seeking bespoke furniture, woodworkers accessing the community shop, and students enrolled in North Bennet Street School courses.
The business serves the local design and maker community rather than high-volume commercial accounts.
The integration of a shared workshop, teaching role, and custom production reflects a model built on skill-sharing and low-impact making.
